items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate, affects so many other projections including Justin Herbert. Game at 4pm ET. Schefter/Rapoport: Q after practicing, ETR Q.
items.why: Rib injury; practiced Friday per Rapoport.
items.implication: Biggest slate Q; Herbert projections swing hard if out; Quentin Johnston boost possible.
items.opportunity: If out, expanded routes/targets for LAC WRs like Quentin Johnston; if in, full role.

items.text: Texans ruled out WR Nico Collins due to hamstring injury for Sunday vs Bengals. Corroborated by Rapoport and ETR as OUT.
items.why: Hamstring injury from Wednesday practice, DNP Thu/Fri, Grade 1 strain.
items.implication: Major target vacuum in HOU offense; WR crumbs and TE boost expected.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining HOU pass-catchers, especially TE.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints. ETR groups with Ja'Kobi Lane as OUT/DOUBTFUL; BAL WR room down to crumbs.
items.implication: Reduced BAL passing volume distribution; hierarchy shift.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets for remaining Ravens WRs/TEs like Mark Andrews.

items.text: Raiders listing TE Brock Bowers as doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee injury, per HC Klint Kubiak. ETR has as OUT/DOUBTFUL.
items.implication: LV TE production crater; slow-paced game vs LAC per ETR Thorman.
items.opportunity: Potential snaps/targets to other LV pass-catchers or RBs if out.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers right now, do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in his 2026 debut? ETR lists as IN. AJ Brown IR/high ankle.
items.why: NE needs playmakers with AJ Brown out long-term; debut opportunity vs schedule.
items.implication: Potential 10+ touch role expanding over Stevenson.
items.opportunity: Carries, targets, red-zone in NE backfield vacuum.

items.text: We're giving Christian McCaffrey a bump off Week 1 usage regardless, but Kaelon Black (groin) status does matter. ETR Q on Black.
items.why: Week 1 usage strong; Black groin Q could further consolidate.
items.opportunity: Snaps, carries, routes expansion if Black limited.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back, but Burrow said he would play. ETR notes said he's playing.
items.why: Back injury; coach indicated good to go, Burrow self-reported playing.
items.implication: CIN offense full strength likely vs HOU without Collins.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/usage for Chase/Higgins/Brown if plays.

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE vs IND: handled 21 of 24 team RB touches through three quarters (74% snap rate), targeted on 40% of routes. Indy gave up 163 yards/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Dominant Week 1 utilization + soft IND run D.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 tied Bijan; 19% target share last 10 games; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
Justin Jefferson LOVE @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz Week 1; averages 93 yards/18.0 PPG in 6 career games with Wentz. Soft Bears D vs WRs.
items.why: Massive volume with Wentz starting (Murray OUT).
items.opportunity: High target share, yards, TDs with Wentz.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: RB9 utilization Week 1, 26% target share, every RB red-zone touch. CLE allowed 121 rush yards/4.8 YPC; out-routed Gainwell.
items.why: Full red-zone/goal-line and receiving role + soft matchup.

items.text: DeVonta Smith LOVE @ TEN: 27% target share, 13.7 aDOT with 3 deep looks Week 1. TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR; 6th-most PPG to WRs.
items.why: Strong usage + elite matchup vs TEN secondary.

items.text: Dak Prescott LOVE vs WAS: averaged 21.3 PPG at home last year; WAS torched for 14.5 YPC/3 TDs Week 1. DAL top-5 implied total in high-total game.
items.why: Home smash spot vs leaky WAS pass D, high total.
items.opportunity: Passing volume, TDs in shootout potential.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr. HATE vs SEA: 8% target share Week 1 (5th on team), zero RZ. SEA 3rd-fewest PPG to WRs. Travis Etienne HATE @ BAL: split rushes, Kamara expected back squeezes role; underdog script.
items.why: MHJ low share/no RZ + tough SEA; Etienne squeezed by Kamara return + bad script.
items.implication: Sit/fade both; Kamara IN per ETR boosts him reverse.
items.opportunity: Low for MHJ/Etienne; Kamara role expansion.
